reassignModal.clearNote: Removes the proxy from every selected profile (they connect directly).
reassignModal.limited: Assigned {{assigned}} - {{skipped}} profile(s) had no proxy left in the source.
reassignModal.socks4Chromium: {{count}} profile(s) open in Chromium, which will not launch through a SOCKS4 proxy (DNS would leak). Switch them to Firefox or give them a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy.

general.name: Name
general.noBuilds: Google Chrome is not installed and no Chrome build is downloaded. Download a version below before you open this profile.
general.identityHelpPre: Runs the same real Chrome build above, but presents as the chosen Chromium browser - UA token, Sec-CH-UA brands and navigator identity all match, while TLS/JA4 stay genuine (it
general.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas, for example: vip, warm-up.
general.cookiePlaceholder: Paste cookies as JSON or Netscape (cookies.txt)
general.cookieHint: Saving imports these cookies into the profile (Chromium profiles only). Each cookie needs its domain, so paste JSON or Netscape (cookies.txt); plain Name=Value pairs cannot be imported.
general.crossOsWarning: This profile claims {{os}} but runs on {{host}}. Host fonts, canvas raster and the real TLS/JS-engine behaviour still say {{host}}, so scanners can spot the mismatch. Use {{host}} unless you specifically need a cross-OS profile.
general.antidetectHelp: Launch this profile on the native fingerprint-chromium engine - applies per-profile canvas / WebGL / UA / platform / timezone settings at the binary level, hides navigator.webdriver, and blocks the WebRTC leak. Requires the engine installed (Browsers page). Off = standard Chrome. The global Settings toggle still applies to profiles left off.
general.launchesAutoReal: Auto: this profile opens in Google Chrome {{major}}, installed on this computer.
general.launchesAutoDownloaded: Auto: Google Chrome is not installed, so this profile opens in the newest downloaded build, Chrome {{major}}.
general.launchesPinnedReal: Chrome {{major}} is selected: this profile opens in the installed Google Chrome {{major}}.
general.launchesPinnedDownloaded: Chrome {{major}} is selected: this profile opens in the downloaded Chrome {{major}} build.
general.launchesPinnedMissing: Chrome {{major}} is selected but not downloaded yet, so this profile opens on Auto (Chrome {{auto}}) until you download it.
general.versionRule: Auto uses the installed Google Chrome, or the newest downloaded build when Chrome is not installed. A version you pick opens that version: the installed Google Chrome when it is that version, otherwise the downloaded build. Profiles that load SoftGlaze extensions open in a downloaded build.
general.uaWarnEngine: This User-Agent says {{family}}, but the profile opens in Chromium. It is applied as picked, yet sites can tell from how the browser behaves (TLS, JavaScript features) that it is not {{family}}. Use Auto or a Chrome User-Agent unless you need this one.
general.uaWarnVersion: This User-Agent says Chrome {{ua}}, but the profile opens in Chrome {{launch}}. It is applied as picked; sites that compare it with what the browser can really do can see the difference. Pick a Chrome {{launch}} User-Agent, or Auto.
general.uaWarnFirefox: Firefox keeps its own User-Agent unless you pick a Firefox one, so this User-Agent is not used.

uaFamily.webkit: Safari (or an iPhone or iPad browser)

proxy.connectionFailedNoReason: The proxy did not answer. Check the host, port, username and password.
proxy.pasteTip: 💡 Tip: Paste your proxy "host:port:user:pass" into the Host field to auto-fill.
proxy.noSaved: No saved proxies yet - add them on the Proxy Pool page.
proxy.freeWarning: Free proxy, run by a stranger: never use this profile to sign in to accounts, enter passwords or pay.
proxy.socks4Chromium: Chromium cannot send DNS lookups through SOCKS4, so this profile will not open with this proxy (every site would be looked up outside it). Choose Firefox on the General tab, or use a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy. The proxy itself is saved either way.
proxy.rotationHelp: Each launch takes the next ticked proxy (or a random one). The first ticked proxy is also saved as the profile's own proxy, which the Sticky proxy policy uses. This is the same pool as Proxy Rotation on the profile's row.
proxy.rotationNoProxies: No proxies in your pool yet. Add them on the Proxy Pool page. Free proxies cannot join a rotation pool.
proxy.quicWarning: ⚠️ Warning: Only enable this on premium, high-quality proxies that fully support UDP tracking isolation. Enabling QUIC unlocks HTTP/3 speeds but can cause network leaks on poor setups. Default is Disabled (Maximum Stealth).
proxy.localHelp: A proxy program running on this computer (for example a VPN client or Clash). The host is 127.0.0.1: enter the port it listens on and pick the protocol it speaks. It is saved as an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy at 127.0.0.1.
proxy.httpsHelp: HTTPS: the connection to the proxy itself is encrypted (TLS). Most proxies sold as "HTTP/HTTPS" are HTTP proxies: choose HTTP for those. Check network tests this proxy over TLS.

platform.startupHint: URLs to open automatically when the profile launches.
platform.twoFactorHint: Paste the 2FA secret seed for this account. Softglaze generates live 6-digit codes - copy them with one click from the Profiles list (🔑 2FA badge).

fp.webrtcDesc: Controls WebRTC behavior to prevent real IP leaks while keeping compatibility.
fp.timezoneDesc: Browser timezone matches proxy location or your system.
fp.locationDesc: Geolocation API permission behavior and coordinates.
fp.languageDesc: Navigator language code for website requests.
fp.displayLanguageDesc: The language of the browser's own menus, and the language pages get for dates and numbers (Intl). What sites get as the visitor's languages comes from Language above.
fp.screenResolutionDesc: Dimensions reported to websites. Keep consistent with your device/OS.
fp.hardwareNoiseSub: Canvas, WebGL, audio noise & GPU metadata
fp.canvasNoiseDesc: On the standard engine this switch does not change 2D canvas drawings. Only the fingerprint-chromium engine changes canvas, and it does so whether this switch is on or off.
fp.webglMetadataDesc: Real (recommended) reports your true GPU consistently across the page, workers AND service worker - no mismatch. Custom sets a different GPU string but a service worker still shows the real one, which detectors flag.
fp.webgpuDesc: Modern replacement for WebGL in newer browsers.
fp.hardwareConfigSub: CPU cores, RAM, device name & MAC address
fp.deviceNameDesc: This profile's computer name, unique in your workspace. No website can read a computer name through a browser. SoftGlaze uses it in Firefox profiles: as the device name in a Firefox account (Sync, Send Tab) and as the computer name Firefox sends to a site that asks for Windows sign-in (NTLM). Chromium profiles cannot use it: Chrome always takes this computer's real name for its own sync and for Windows sign-in.
fp.genDeviceName: Generate a new device name for this OS
fp.macAddressDesc: This profile's network card address, unique in your workspace. No website can read a MAC address through a browser, and neither Chrome nor Firefox sends it anywhere, so it changes nothing a site can see. It stays with the profile (export, import, templates) as part of its device record.
fp.portScanWarning: Replaces window.fetch, XHR.open and WebSocket inside the page. Some sites detect the patched functions and flag the session. Leave this off unless you specifically need local-port protection.
fp.webrtcHelpForward: With a proxy, WebRTC cannot send anything outside it: sites see no local or real IP, and no WebRTC address at all unless they relay through their own TURN server.
fp.webrtcHelpReplace: Like Forward, and a site that asks for your public address (through a STUN server) is given the proxy's exit IP, as a computer behind that IP would show. Needs a proxy; without one it works as Forward.
fp.webrtcHelpReal: WebRTC works as in a normal browser and can show your real IP even behind the proxy.
fp.webrtcHelpDisabled: WebRTC is removed from pages (RTCPeerConnection is missing). Some sites notice that.
fp.webrtcFirefox: Firefox profiles always run with WebRTC turned off.
fp.locationHelp_prompt: A site must ask, and the browser asks you each time. If you allow it, the site gets the profile's location (custom, or the proxy's); with neither, your real one.
fp.locationHelp_granted: Sites get the profile's location (custom, or the proxy's) without a prompt. With no proxy and no custom location the browser asks instead, so your real location is never shared silently.
fp.locationHelp_denied: Location is blocked for every site.
fp.displayLanguageInvalid: Write a language code such as en-US, de or pt-BR.
fp.fontsHelpDefault: Sites see the fonts installed on this computer, with a little noise in canvas text measurements.
fp.fontsHelpReal: Sites see the fonts installed on this computer, unchanged.
fp.fontsHelpCustom: Sites can see only the fonts on this list, and only those installed on this computer; every other font measures as missing (page text, canvas and FontFace checks). One font per line.
fp.mediaAutoHelp: Sites see one microphone, one speaker and one camera, with names that fit the OS.
fp.mediaEditHelp: Sites see this many devices of each kind. 0 means none: a site that asks for that kind then finds no device.
fp.webgpuHelpBased: WebGPU reports the same GPU maker and family as WebGL: vendor "{{vendor}}", architecture "{{architecture}}".
fp.webgpuHelpBasedReal: WebGL reports the real GPU, so WebGPU does too (they already match).
fp.webgpuHelpReal: WebGPU reports the real GPU, even when WebGL shows another one.
fp.webgpuHelpDisabled: navigator.gpu is hidden, as in a browser without WebGPU.
fp.deviceNameInvalidWindows: A Windows computer name has at most 15 letters, digits and hyphens.
fp.deviceNameInvalid: Use at most 63 letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens, underscores or apostrophes, starting with a letter or digit.
fp.macInvalid: Write six pairs of hex digits, like 3C:A9:F4:12:34:56.
fp.macMulticast: This is a group address, which no network card has: the first pair must be an even number.
fp.hwHelpDefault: The browser decides whether to use the graphics card.
fp.hwHelpOn: The graphics card is always used, also when the browser would avoid it (Chrome --ignore-gpu-blocklist, Firefox forced acceleration).
fp.hwHelpOff: No graphics card: pages are drawn in software (Chrome --disable-gpu). WebGL may then be unavailable.
fp.webgpuHelpNative: On the fingerprint engine, WebGPU is the engine's own: it builds the WebGL GPU from its seed, so SoftGlaze cannot match WebGPU to it.

errors.noCookies: No saved cookies found for this profile yet.
errors.syncMin: Select at least two profiles to synchronize.
errors.proxyHostPort: Please enter at least Host and Port to check.
errors.pickSavedProxy: Choose a saved proxy to check.
errors.rotationEmpty: Tick at least one proxy for the rotation pool, or choose another proxy setting.
errors.rotationNotSaved: The profile was saved with the first pool proxy as its own proxy, but the rotation pool was not saved: {{reason}}
errors.rotationNotCleared: The profile was saved, but its old rotation pool is still on, so launches still rotate: {{reason}}
errors.cookiesNotImported: The profile was saved, but its cookies were not imported: {{reason}} You can import them later with Manage Cookies on the profile's row.

cookieErrors.jsonInvalid: The cookies look like JSON but cannot be read. Check for a missing bracket, quote or comma.
cookieErrors.jsonShape: JSON cookies must be a list ([...]) or an object with a "cookies" list.
cookieErrors.noDomain: None of these cookies has a domain or URL, so they cannot be stored for a site.
cookieErrors.nameValue: Name=Value cookies have no domain, so SoftGlaze cannot tell which site they belong to. Paste them as JSON or Netscape (cookies.txt), for example exported with a cookie extension.
cookieErrors.unrecognised: These cookies are not in a format SoftGlaze can import. Use JSON or Netscape (cookies.txt).
cookieErrors.firefox: Cookie import works for Chromium profiles only. Clear the Cookie box to save this Firefox profile.

permNotes.skipped: Profiles left unchanged: {{count}}. You may not edit them (they are shared with you for use only, or belong to someone else).
permNotes.cloneNoProxy: Copied. The original's proxy is not available to you, so the copy has no proxy yet: assign one before launching it.
permNotes.cloneNoGroup: Copied. The original's group is not visible to you, so the copy is not in a group.
permNotes.proxyMissingTitle: Set to use a proxy, but it has none (its proxy was deleted, or is not available to you). Assign a proxy in the editor before launching.
